candidates.description: This vector represents concepts related to exertion, interaction, and opposing or cooperative social and physical forces.
This vector activates on famous historical figures, political leaders, and notable personalities, often responding to name suffixes or specific name components.
This feature vector represents French auxiliary and linking verbs conjugated in various tenses and moods.
This vector represents common English prefixes used to modify word meanings.
This vector represents universal quantifiers, totality, and words related to "all" or "every" across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the letter sequence "ss" and words ending with or containing the "-ass" or "-ess" sound and spelling patterns.
This feature vector represents the letter sequence "-ont-" or words containing the French preposition "ont/dont/mont" and similar phonetic endings.
This vector activates strongly on the suffix sequence "-ient" and phonetically or orthographically similar subword tokens across multiple languages.
This vector represents abstract concepts related to intellectual history, philosophy, and human culture across different languages.
This vector represents morphological suffixes and inflections commonly found in French verbs and adjectives.
